researchNotes.chord-drill: Read components/drills/chord-drill/chord-drill.tsx, hooks/useChordDrill.ts, lib/chord-drill.ts. Loop: pick root+quality (Single Shape/Family Cycle/Extended Family), Start Drill (gated on MIDI connected), countdown -> hold chord until timer stops on match, reps per round, round graded by first-chord time (Again/Hard/Good) and auto-sent to Anki; personal bests per chord.
researchNotes.arpeggios: Read components/drills/arpeggios/arpeggios.tsx, hooks/useArpeggios.ts, lib/arpeggios.ts. Loop: minor-11 cell shows LH pedal to hold, then RH sequence lights note by note on the cell strip; Laps/Misses/This-lap counters; miss filter excludes selected notes; auto-graded by misses to Anki on lap completion; Next chord advances.
researchNotes.root-cycling: Read components/drills/root-cycling/root-cycling.tsx, lib/root-cycling.ts, hooks/useRootCycling.ts. Loop: fixed quality (Chord mode) or canonical minor-11 shape (Arpeggio mode) called at a random root from the Root Pool each rep; Skip to next root / Next root buttons; Root / Roots completed / Misses counters.
researchNotes.progression: Read components/drills/progression/progression.tsx, lib/progression.ts, hooks/useProgression.ts. Loop: pick ii-V-I or 12-Bar Blues and a key (C G D A E), Start Loop, step strip walks chord by chord timing each transition; step/loop counters, step+loop chimes, Anki flip on loop; Personal bests keep Best step / Best average / Total loops per type+key.
researchNotes.workshop: Read app/tools/workshop/page.tsx, components/custom-practice/practice-page-editor.tsx + starter-picker.tsx, lib/feature-blocks/registry.ts, lib/custom-practice-storage.ts. Loop: practice page is a draggable grid of blocks (20 in registry: metronome, chord set, on-screen keyboard, practice report, timers, transport, libraries...); starter picker offers guided routes, ready-made pages, or scratch; /marketplace featured pages fork into the store via forkPageIntoStore.

accuracyFixes: Removed the false 'on-screen keyboard, try it right now without any gear' claim: all four drills disable Start until a real MIDI keyboard is connected (components/*/Start disabled={!midiConnected}).
Chord Drill grading corrected: one auto-grade per round from first-chord time (gradeForTime), not per rep.
Root Cycling narrowed from 'carry one idea through all twelve keys' to the actual behavior: random root each rep from a configurable pool, skip to next root.
